mike_chen: @anya i think this is the rule bump we saw earlier when stylelint moved to 14.x — no-trailing-spaces got stricter
anya: yep, our package.json pulled ^14.0.0. Options: pin back to 13.7.x, or add an override in .stylelintrc to turn off that rule.
sara: mid-release — what's the fastest path? revert the merge or hotfix and rerun?
mike_chen: revert slows everything. I can open a tiny hotfix PR that pins stylelint to 13.7.1 and updates lockfile, rerun CI. Should be a <5min change.

anya: proposed patch (one-line change):
```diff
-  "stylelint": "^14.0.0",
+  "stylelint": "13.7.1",
```
sara: ok hold rollout. mike, open PR named hotfix/lint-pin and tag this thread. We'll wait for CI green. :eyes:
